name: Texture Coordinate Conversion
definition: A utility function to convert local/world space coordinates (P) to texture coordinates (uv) for volume sampling. It scales by inverse volume size, adds 0.5 offset, and flips the Y axis.
summary: Texture Coordinate Conversion transforms spatial coordinates into normalized texture coordinates for volume sampling, distinguished by inverse volume scaling, a 0.5 centering offset, and a Y-axis flip.
